# Pre-staged fixtures

Binary `.dump` fixtures for the `005-prestaged-hydration` test suite.
Generated by `generate_fixtures.sh`; the dump files themselves are
gitignored.

## Regenerating

```bash
PG_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres \
  bash tests/fixtures/prestaged/generate_fixtures.sh
```

The fixtures depend on `pg_dump` (from `postgresql-client-16`) and any
reachable Postgres instance. Content is intentionally trivial — the
`.dump` files must only be syntactically valid PGDMP so
`validate_magic_bytes()` and `compute_sha256()` return the right
values. The Stage 2 discovery tests check layout walking, not restore
correctness.

## What's inside (after running the generator)

```
_staging/archive-001/dk-data-files/
    mol_raw/chembl_sample/
        1_chembl_sample.dump
        retry_chembl_sample.dump
    mol_bronze/mol_bronze__pubchem__abc123/
        pubchem.dump
    mol_raw/not_a_dump.txt          ← walker must ignore

_loose_dumps/mol_bronze/
    mol_bronze__clinicaltrials__def456-008.dump
```

This covers: raw layout, bronze-hashed-dir layout, loose-dump layout,
multi-chunk ordering (numbered + retry_), and the non-dump-ignore case.
